640-1981-2415-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
640-1981-2415-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3755-4770-5301-6965.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

215-1753-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-1753-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

341-1170-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: Umori has "Artifact" chosen. You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
341-1170-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Umori.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat.

777-1170-1477-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
777-1170-1477-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

1542-3923-4050-7639.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1542-3923-4050-7639.description:
Declare Wizards of Thay as an attacker. Its myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of it attacking each other opponent.
Holding priority, cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Wizards of Thay.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-4350-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3967-4350-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

457-1458-2350-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-2350-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Stone Calendar.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1765-2921-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

969-2440-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
969-2440-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

338-2034-3490-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2034-3490-5870.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

141-5117-5686.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

1978-3301-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-3301-5527.description:
Animate Five Hundred Year Diary using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-5220-5256-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1036-2060-2919-3525.description:
Activate Wellwisher by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Wellwisher.
Repeat.

4613-4968-6125.description:
Activate Fiendish Panda by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Fiendish Panda triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2279-2292-5058.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1651-5469-5640.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating your choice of a Clue, Food or Blood artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the token and an artifact creature, targeting the artifact creature.
Ertha Jo's second ability triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Transmutation Font.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping Transmutation Font and the artifact creature.
Repeat.

1987-3617-4423-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-3617-4423-5913.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

880-2653-2692.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

405-2232-4050-4772.description:
Cast Resolute Reinforcements by paying {1}{W}.
When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldiers, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

204-1298-2430.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {4}{U}.
Ovika and Sorcerer Class trigger.
Resolve the Ovika trigger, creating five 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin tokens that gain haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each instant and/or sorcery spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Activate the five Phyrexian Goblins by tapping them, adding {4}{U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

586-864-2034-2267-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2034-2267-3125.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

624-2438-2777.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
Phantasmal Image dies, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
